Name: Susan of Emerald Farm - SVE Standalone NPC
Author: DolphinIsNotaFish
Description:
[b]For mod authors[/b]:
I made this content pack as an example of a simple, feature-complete NPC using the latest Content Patcher methods and best practices. Inside the JSON files, you'll find annotations explaining how things work and why they’re done this way. Feel free to dissect it and use it as a reference for your own NPC!

[color=#b6d7a8]﻿[b][size=6]I[/size][size=5]nstallation[/size][/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][i]Content Patcher[/i][/url]﻿ installed.[/*]
[*]Download [b][i]Susan of Emerald Farm[/i][/b].[/*]
[*]Extract the downloaded file into the game's [font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[/list]To uninstall, simply delete [font=Lucida Sans Unicode][CP] Susan of Emerald Farm[/font] from your Mods folder.

[b][color=#a2c4c9][size=6]C[/size][size=5]ompatibility[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Not compatible with [i][b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b][/i], for obvious reasons.[/*]
[*]Should override any mod that changes the area south of the Railroad train stop.[/*]
[/list][b][color=#9fc5e8][size=6]T[/size][size=5]ranslations[/size][/color][/b]
This mod uses i18n. If you want to make a translation for it, feel free to either give it to me (so I could incorporate it into the mod) or upload them yourself (do tell me so I can link to them!).
[spoiler]Built-in
[list]
[*][b]American English[/b] 1.0.0[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
